en.title: November 22: Minor Snow Arrives as a Gyeongja Day Opens 'Wall Top Earth' - 3 Zodiac Animals With the Best Luck Today
en.excerpt: Minor Snow lands today at 4:23pm as a new Gyeongja day opens the 'Wall Top Earth' nayin pair, and the day's own Rat branch sits at the exact peak of a Water trine. Here are the three zodiac animals best placed for it, and why.

fr.title: 22 novembre : la Petite Neige arrive alors qu'un jour Gyeongja ouvre 'la Terre du Haut du Mur' - les 3 signes du zodiaque les plus chanceux aujourd'hui
